Our Sourcing Model

Every product is compliant.
Every price is earned.

GHLS doesn't just resell what everyone else carries. Our procurement team actively works the market to find supply opportunities that let us pass real savings to clinic partners — without sacrificing product quality or regulatory standing.

  • FDA-cleared products only — every SKU in our inventory meets full regulatory requirements.
  • Full documentation provided — lot numbers, expiration dates, and chain of custody on every order.
  • Flexible minimum orders — we work with your actual usage volume, not arbitrary bulk thresholds.
  • One point of contact — not a call center. A dedicated rep who knows your account.
